subject: Re: Kickoff: MolDQN lead-optimization pilot — June status + aromatic-bond risk
body:
Hi both,

Status: QED reproduction done on both configs — bootstrap DQN (two-step schedule) beats naive DQN on mean final QED, 0.041 higher across 20 seeds, matching the paper's ordering. Saoirse vendored SA_Score cleanly and the pipeline runs end-to-end with full episode logs, so every optimized molecule ships with its edit trajectory. Partner A's logP-with-similarity-constraint reward is encoded and training.

The risk has a shape now: Partner B's series is heavily aromatic. Because the MDP can't modify aromatic bonds — including bonds perceived as aromatic when parsing the starting molecule — about 60% of their seed structures have most of their interesting edit space locked. Early runs confirm it: the agent decorates the periphery instead of touching the core, and property gains plateau ~40% below Partner A's.

Recommendation: pilot report presents Partner B as "supported for peripheral optimization only." Not a failure, but it must be in writing.

Wei
